description: Delete FLUF products. By default only the FLUF record is removed and every marketplace listing is left untouched; `also_delist: true` also ends the listings on every marketplace they are live on, which cannot be undone. Deleted FLUF records go to Recently Deleted in the dashboard and can be restored for 60 days. Suited to sold-out or obsolete inventory. Requires Super Seller (API tokens on other plans are read-only and the request returns a 403 'plan limit' error).

also_delist.description: If true, also end the listing on every marketplace the product is live on (cannot be undone). Default false: only the FLUF record is deleted and live marketplace listings stay up.

fluf_ids.description: FLUF product ids to delete (e.g. [12345, 67890]), from the `fluf_id` field of list_products. Max 100 per call.

name: delete_products
